name: Tusaldah Limited
about: Tusaldah Limited manufactures and trades in knitted socks, and head and wrist bands in India. The company operates through the Manufacturing/Trading/Jobwork of Socks, Trading of Yarn, and Trading of Commodities segments. It provides baby, children, ladies and girls, men's, sports, and anti-slip socks, as well as tights for babies and girls. The company was formerly known as High Street Filatex Limited and changed its name to Tusaldah Limited in October 2025. Tusaldah Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Jaipur, India.
